name: careTreatmentBase
description: Care & Treatment and ARV Management, sections 1.1-1.4: the active clients at the locations in the HIV monthly report dataset (etl.hiv_monthly_report_dataset_frozen) for the month ending on endDate -- one row per client -- who started ART this month or are on ART this month, as MOH 731 3.1 and 3.2 count them. Active means seen within 30 days of the appointment, so defaulters of 0-30 days are included. Each client carries an age band, sex, whether they count under MCH/PMTCT and a 1/0 flag per figure; the totals sum the flags and the linelist lists the clients with a 1, so the two always agree. WHO stage, CD4, breastfeeding and the refill date come from the client's row in etl.flat_hiv_summary_v15b at that encounter, and stability from its latest non-voided 12108 / 12127 obs (as MOH 731 3.5).

join.joinCondition: stab.obs_id = (SELECT MAX(o.obs_id) FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.encounter_id = fhs.encounter_id AND o.concept_id = 12108 AND o.voided = 0)
nes.obs_id = (SELECT MAX(o.obs_id) FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.encounter_id = fhs.encounter_id AND o.concept_id = 12127 AND o.voided = 0)

expressionOptions.expression: FLOOR(h.age)

CASE WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 1 THEN 'under_1' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 5 THEN '1_4' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 10 THEN '5_9' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 15 THEN '10_14' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 20 THEN '15_19' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 25 THEN '20_24' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 30 THEN '25_29' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 35 THEN '30_34' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 40 THEN '35_39' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 45 THEN '40_44' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 50 THEN '45_49' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 55 THEN '50_54' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 60 THEN '55_59' WHEN FLOOR(h.age) < 65 THEN '60_64' ELSE '65_plus' END
IF(h.gender = 'F' AND FLOOR(h.age) >= 10 AND (h.pregnant_this_month = 1 OR fhs.is_mother_breastfeeding = 1 OR l.name LIKE '%MCH%'), 1, 0)
DATE(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date))
DATE(h.encounter_date)
DATE(h.rtc_date)
DATE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date)

IF(COALESCE(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) >= 0, 0) = 1, GREATEST(ROUND(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) / 30), 1), NULL)
IF(fhs.cd4_1 IS NOT NULL AND fhs.cd4_1_date >= DATE_SUB(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), fhs.cd4_1, NULL)
IF(fhs.cd4_1 IS NOT NULL AND fhs.cd4_1_date >= DATE_SUB(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), DATE(fhs.cd4_1_date), NULL)
IF(fhs.cd4_percent_1 IS NOT NULL AND fhs.cd4_percent_1_date >= DATE_SUB(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), fhs.cd4_percent_1, NULL)

CASE WHEN COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12106, 0) = 1 THEN 'Established' WHEN NOT (COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12106, 0) = 1) AND COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12107 OR nes.value_coded IN (9070, 12266), 0) = 1 THEN 'Not established' END
IF(COALESCE(h.pregnant_this_month = 1, 0) = 1, 'Yes', 'No')
IF(COALESCE(fhs.is_mother_breastfeeding = 1, 0) = 1, 'Yes', 'No')
IF(COALESCE(h.on_tb_tx_this_month = 1, 0) = 1, 'Yes', 'No')
IF(COALESCE(h.started_ipt_this_month = 1, 0) = 1, 'Yes', 'No')
DATE(h.vl_1_date)
IF(COALESCE(h.started_art_this_month = 1, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.started_art_this_month = 1 AND fhs.cd4_1 IS NOT NULL AND fhs.cd4_1_date >= DATE_SUB(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND fhs.cd4_1 < 200, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.started_art_this_month = 1 AND fhs.cd4_1 IS NOT NULL AND fhs.cd4_1_date >= DATE_SUB(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND fhs.cd4_1 >= 200, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.started_art_this_month = 1 AND NOT (fhs.cd4_1 IS NOT NULL AND fhs.cd4_1_date >= DATE_SUB(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)) AND fhs.cd4_percent_1 IS NOT NULL AND fhs.cd4_percent_1_date >= DATE_SUB(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.started_art_this_month = 1 AND NOT (fhs.cd4_1 IS NOT NULL AND fhs.cd4_1_date >= DATE_SUB(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)) AND NOT (fhs.cd4_percent_1 IS NOT NULL AND fhs.cd4_percent_1_date >= DATE_SUB(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)), 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.started_art_this_month = 1 AND h.pregnant_this_month = 1, 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.started_art_this_month = 1 AND fhs.is_mother_breastfeeding = 1, 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.started_art_this_month = 1 AND h.on_tb_tx_this_month = 1, 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.started_art_this_month = 1 AND h.started_ipt_this_month = 1, 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND COALESCE(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date) > DATE_SUB(h.endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), 0) = 1 AND fhs.cur_who_stage IN (1, 2), 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND COALESCE(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date) > DATE_SUB(h.endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), 0) = 1 AND fhs.cur_who_stage IN (3, 4), 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND COALESCE(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date) > DATE_SUB(h.endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), 0) = 1 AND COALESCE(fhs.cur_who_stage IN (1, 2, 3, 4), 0) = 0, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND NOT (COALESCE(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date) > DATE_SUB(h.endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), 0) = 1) AND NOT (COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12106, 0) = 1) AND COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12107 OR nes.value_coded IN (9070, 12266), 0) = 1, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND NOT (COALESCE(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date) > DATE_SUB(h.endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), 0) = 1) AND COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12106, 0) = 1, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND NOT (COALESCE(COALESCE(h.arv_first_regimen_start_date, h.arv_start_date) > DATE_SUB(h.endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), 0) = 1) AND NOT (COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12106, 0) = 1) AND NOT (NOT (COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12106, 0) = 1) AND COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12107 OR nes.value_coded IN (9070, 12266), 0) = 1), 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND COALESCE(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) >= 0, 0) = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) / 30) <= 1, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND COALESCE(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) >= 0, 0) = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) / 30) = 2, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND COALESCE(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) >= 0, 0) = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) / 30) = 3, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND COALESCE(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) >= 0, 0) = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) / 30) = 4, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND COALESCE(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) >= 0, 0) = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) / 30) = 5, 0) = 1, 1, 0)

IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND COALESCE(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) >= 0, 0) = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) / 30) >= 6, 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND NOT (COALESCE(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(fhs.med_pickup_rtc_date, h.rtc_date), h.encounter_date) >= 0, 0) = 1), 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND h.eligible_for_vl = 1, 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND h.eligible_for_vl = 1 AND h.vl_in_past_year = 1 AND h.vl_1 IS NOT NULL AND h.vl_1 < 50, 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND h.eligible_for_vl = 1 AND h.vl_in_past_year = 1 AND h.vl_1 IS NOT NULL AND h.vl_1 BETWEEN 50 AND 199, 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND h.eligible_for_vl = 1 AND h.vl_in_past_year = 1 AND h.vl_1 IS NOT NULL AND h.vl_1 BETWEEN 200 AND 999, 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND h.eligible_for_vl = 1 AND h.vl_in_past_year = 1 AND h.vl_1 IS NOT NULL AND h.vl_1 >= 1000, 0) = 1, 1, 0)
IF(COALESCE(h.on_art_this_month = 1 AND h.eligible_for_vl = 1 AND NOT (COALESCE(h.vl_in_past_year = 1 AND h.vl_1 IS NOT NULL, 0) = 1), 0) = 1, 1, 0)
